data.narrative:
Marathon Fusion is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Adam Rutkowski and Kyle Schiller that has raised $10.9M to date. The broader nuclear energy sector comp universe includes three public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and eight private firms, among them Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

Our valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to comp set constraints. The Stage-Progression method, which applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the subsequent financing stage, uses the $10.9M total raised as a proxy base value and implies a valuation of $27M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable here: while six same-sector peers exist, the narrowly-filtered peer set (requiring same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier alignment) yielded fewer than three comparable datapoints, making sector-wide median comparison unreliable and potentially misleading.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $31M, with a median of $27M. This range reflects typical Seed-to-Series A progression multiples in deep-tech energy. The principal uncertainty is the single-method reliance; a more robust triangulation would require either additional Seed-stage nuclear peers at comparable capital efficiency or revenue-based metrics to anchor a DCF view. Founder track record and technical differentiation in reactor design remain key drivers not quantified here.
